steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Vikunja at http://127.0.0.1:8096/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password literally as that text), then open the project 'Bench Project', and report the titles of all tasks whose title starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in Vikunja, create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task'. Give it a description that includes the text {{runid}}. Set its due date to 2026-12-31 and its priority to High. Add the EXISTING label named 'Backend' — when typing in the label field, pick the existing 'Backend' label from the suggestion list that appears; do NOT let it create a new label. Open the task's own page afterwards and verify/report: the title, that the description contains {{runid}}, the due date shown, the priority shown, the label shown, and the task identifier exactly as the app displays it (it looks like BENCH-<number>).

03-add: On the task page for the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' (identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}) in Vikunja, add a comment whose text includes {{runid}} (e.g. 'Comment for {{runid}} bench task'), submit it, and confirm it appears. Then re-read the task page and report exactly what it displays for: the priority (should show High), the label chip (should show Backend), the due date, the description, and the identifier {{02-create.task_identifier}}. If the priority or label is not showing as expected, fix it and report what you did.

04-verify: Verify two things in Vikunja and report: (1) In the labels list (e.g. via the labels menu/section), confirm there is exactly ONE label named 'Backend' — not two — and report how many labels named Backend exist. (2) In the project 'Bench Project', confirm the three tasks with titles starting 'Seed:' still exist with their original titles, and report them. Do not modify anything.
